title: New-Business Eligibility Rule Increases to 20% - Citizens Property Insurance Corporation
claims: Citizens states that for any residential Commercial Lines new-business risk to be eligible for Citizens coverage, the premium for coverage from an authorized insurer must be at least 20 percent higher than the premium for comparable coverage from Citizens.
Citizens states that the prior rule's threshold was 15 percent for commercial residential policies.
Citizens states that the change was made in response to Senate Bill 2A, which was signed by the governor on December 16, 2022.
updateCadence: Citizens eligibility rules change with legislation; re-verify against Citizens' current underwriting manuals.
